bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; clarifying that there is no duty to retreat before making a threat to use force in self-defense in certain circumstances; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.06, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.06, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 5.+]

[+No duty to retreat under certain circumstances; threats of using force.+]

[+A person authorized to use force in compliance with subdivision 1, clause (3), is not required to retreat, even if there is an opportunity to do so, before making a reasonable threat to use force. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; clarifying that there is no duty to retreat before making a threat to use force in self-defense in certain circumstances; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.06, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.06, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 5.

No duty to retreat under certain circumstances; threats of using force.

A person authorized to use force in compliance with subdivision 1, clause (3), is not required to retreat, even if there is an opportunity to do so, before making a reasonable threat to use force.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: No duty to retreat under certain circumstances; threats of using force.
A person authorized to use force in compliance with subdivision 1, clause (3), is not required to retreat, even if there is an opportunity to do so, before making a reasonable threat to use force.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
